descriptors.name: grain size
descriptors.physical_meaning: Average diameter of crystalline grains in microstructure
descriptors.rationale: Controls strength via Hall-Petch relation and diffusion kinetics

representation.notes: Mean intercept length or equivalent circle diameter

quality.loss_reason: Averaging loses full grain size distribution information
quality.notes: Different distributions yield identical means; method-dependent measurement

descriptors.name: grain boundary misorientation
descriptors.physical_meaning: Crystallographic orientation difference between adjacent grains
descriptors.rationale: Distinguishes low-angle versus high-angle boundaries affecting deformation and energy

quality.loss_reason: Binning loses exact angle values and spatial arrangement
quality.notes: Histogram preserves distribution shape; bin resolution determines fidelity

descriptors.name: texture intensity
descriptors.physical_meaning: Degree of preferred crystallographic orientation in polycrystal
descriptors.rationale: Quantifies anisotropy in mechanical and physical properties

representation.notes: Single metric like J-index or max intensity

quality.loss_reason: Single scalar collapses full orientation distribution function
quality.notes: Different texture types produce same index; loses spatial and component detail

descriptors.name: grain aspect ratio
descriptors.physical_meaning: Ratio of longest to shortest grain dimension
descriptors.rationale: Indicates grain elongation from processing affecting directional properties

representation.encoding: real value greater than or equal to 1
representation.notes: Mean aspect ratio across grain population

quality.loss_reason: Mean erases distribution and orientation direction of elongation
quality.notes: Loses directional information and variance across grain population

descriptors.name: dislocation density
descriptors.physical_meaning: Total length of dislocations per unit volume
descriptors.rationale: Governs strain hardening and stored energy state

representation.encoding: real positive value in logarithmic scale

quality.loss_reason: Scalar ignores dislocation type, arrangement, and spatial heterogeneity
quality.notes: Different dislocation configurations yield same density; measurement method varies
